Neogenesis.title: Neogenesis
Neogenesis.description: You have obtained the power to regenerate your cells at impossible rates

first_tick_commands: item replace entity @s weapon.mainhand with eop:dna_capsule{mender:"eop_true",display:{Name:'["",{"text":"Neogenesis","color":"light_purple","italic":false},{"text":" DNA Capsule","italic":false}]'}}

Secondary.Ability.title: Withering Touch
Secondary.Ability.description: Touch entities to begin a decaying process on their cells. §dBattlemode §fmust be enabled via keybind. §dRight Click §fto use this ability

Increase.Regen.Unlock.title: Enhanced Cellular Regeneration
Increase.Regen.Unlock.description: Increase your body's already powerful regeneration. §dCan be passed to targets §fif activated while using Healing Touch

Heal.Unlock.title: Healing Touch
Heal.Unlock.description: Heal an entity you are in direct contact with

Heal.Commands.title: null
commands: execute positioned ^ ^1 ^1 run execute unless entity @e[palladium.power=eop:effects/being_healed] run superpower add eop:effects/being_healed @e[distance=..0.9,tag=!Mender,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,limit=1,sort=nearest]

Augment.Unlock.title: Cellular Augmentation
Augment.Unlock.description: Set your cells into overdrive to gain boosted stats. §dCan be passed to targets §fif activated while using Healing Touch

Augment.Hand.title: Cellular Augmentation
first_tick_commands: execute positioned ^ ^1 ^1 run effect give @e[type=!armor_stand,distance=..0.9,limit=1,sort=nearest,tag=!Infinity,tag=!EOP.Phasing] eop:augment 30 0 true
execute at @e[distance=0.1..3,limit=1,sort=nearest] run particle poof ~ ~ ~ 0.4 1 0.4 0 20 force

Bone.Blade.Unlock.title: Bone Blade
Bone.Blade.Unlock.description: Manipulate your cells to form a boney blade

first_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound eop:diamond_transform master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound eop:claw master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
last_tick_commands: execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 0 run playsound eop:diamond_transform master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2
execute if score @s EOP.Bone.Type matches 1 run playsound eop:claw master @a ~ ~ ~ 1 2

Immortality.Unlock.title: Instant Cellular Regeneration
Immortality.Unlock.description: Increase the regeneration speed of your cells by several thousand percent, essentially making you immortal. §dCan be passed to targets §fif activated while using Healing Touch

Immortality.Hand.title: Instant Cellular Regeneration
first_tick_commands: execute positioned ^ ^1 ^1 run effect give @e[type=!armor_stand,tag=!EOP.Phasing,tag=!Infinity,distance=..0.9,limit=1,sort=nearest] eop:cellular_immortality 15 0 true
